\section[(dialogue)]{Can, want and places — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R95-first-pass-can-want-and-places}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a curtain; a tent and a cushion.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to be able to, to have to, to manage, a need, a trade
  \item to want, I would like, to prefer, to hope, to wish
  \item an airport, a stop, a village; a country, a cinema, a theatre
  \item a town hall, a supermarket, a petrol station, a swimming pool, a stadium
  \item a factory, an office, a corner, a crossroads, traffic lights
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To be able to? (\textbf{potere}.) To have to? (\textbf{dovere}.) To manage? (\textbf{riuscire}.) A need? (\textbf{il bisogno}.) A trade? (\textbf{il mestiere}.) To want? (\textbf{volere}.) I would like? (\textbf{vorrei}.) To prefer? (\textbf{preferire}.) To hope? (\textbf{sperare}.) To wish? (\textbf{desiderare}.) An airport? (\textbf{l'aeroporto}.) A stop? (\textbf{la fermata}.) A village; a country? (\textbf{il paese}.) A cinema? (\textbf{il cinema}.) A theatre? (\textbf{il teatro}.) A town hall? (\textbf{il municipio}.) A supermarket? (\textbf{il supermercato}.) A petrol station? (\textbf{il distributore}.) A swimming pool? (\textbf{la piscina}.) A stadium? (\textbf{lo stadio}.) A factory? (\textbf{la fabbrica}.) An office? (\textbf{l'ufficio}.) A corner? (\textbf{l'angolo}.) A crossroads? (\textbf{l'incrocio}.) Traffic lights? (\textbf{il semaforo}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Getting around and the house — a second pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R95-second-pass-getting-around-and-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a car park and a lift.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a car park, a lift, the north, the south, the west
  \item straight on, in front, behind, next to, between
  \item opposite, the underground, a taxi, a ferry, a journey
  \item holidays, a bicycle, a motorbike, a ship, a boat
  \item a rug, a television, a computer, a fridge, an oven
  \item a shower, a bathtub, a shelf, a curtain; a tent, a cushion
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A car park? (\textbf{il parcheggio}.) A lift? (\textbf{l'ascensore}.) The north? (\textbf{il nord}.) The south? (\textbf{il sud}.) The west? (\textbf{l'ovest}.) Straight on? (\textbf{dritto}.) In front? (\textbf{davanti}.) Behind? (\textbf{dietro}.) Next to? (\textbf{accanto}.) Between? (\textbf{tra}.) Opposite? (\textbf{di fronte}.) The underground? (\textbf{la metropolitana}.) A taxi? (\textbf{il taxi}.) A ferry? (\textbf{il traghetto}.) A journey? (\textbf{il viaggio}.) Holidays? (\textbf{le vacanze}.) A bicycle? (\textbf{la bicicletta}.) A motorbike? (\textbf{la moto}.) A ship? (\textbf{la nave}.) A boat? (\textbf{la barca}.) A rug? (\textbf{il tappeto}.) A television? (\textbf{il televisore}.) A computer? (\textbf{il computer}.) A fridge? (\textbf{il frigorifero}.) An oven? (\textbf{il forno}.) A shower? (\textbf{la doccia}.) A bathtub? (\textbf{la vasca}.) A shelf? (\textbf{lo scaffale}.) A curtain; a tent? (\textbf{la tenda}.) A cushion? (\textbf{il cuscino}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
